godot_patches: SPZ_NO_PARALLEL_CODEC selects existing sequential codec paths, avoiding unmanaged std::async work.
PackedGaussians::at avoids referencing the empty SH vector for degree 0.
PackedGaussian::unpack reads legacy Half values with memcpy rather than an unaligned typed pointer.
Legacy gzip membuf supports bounded seek/tell so the official extension reader can validate remaining bytes and preserve coordinate descriptors.

V4 preallocation validation replaces the false compressed-size ratio bound with exact TOC/Zstd frame extents and a fixed 1-GiB expanded packed-payload cap; Godot adapter point/input/working-memory caps remain mandatory.
